event.distribution_pattern: Domestic Only: NC, OH, MD, VA

products.product_description: AnnaSea Wasabi Ahi Poke Hawaiian Poke Kits
products.code_info: Wasabi Ahi Hawaiian Poke Kit, UPC code 99221 0011 O. Products have best by dates of: 5/23/2020, 6/11/2020, 6/12/2020, and 6/14/2020.
products.reason_for_recall: ALDI has voluntarily recalled AnnaSea Wasabi Ahi Poke Hawaiian Poke Kits and Limu Ahi Poke Hawaiian Poke Kits due to storing the products at temperatures above freezing prior to consumption which can render the products unsafe for consumption.
